items.title: 25.4.1 Rapid Growth of Human Populations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of rapid human population growth (PDF 237-238).

blocks.text: 1700s ke shuru se technology ki tabdeeliyon ne insanon ko khoraak par zyada qaboo, shikariyon se behtar difa aur bohat si bimariyon ke ilaaj diye, aur unhein mausam ke aage kam kamzor banaya. In tabdeeliyon ne insanon ko apne maskan ki carrying capacity barhane di.

Duniya ke taqreeban 16% (1.28 billion) log taraqqi yafta aur 84% (6.72 billion) taraqqi pazeer mulkon mein rehte hain. Pakistan Bureau of Statistics ke mutabiq 2023 ki mardum shumari mein Pakistan ki aabadi 241.49 million aur sarkari sharah-e-izafa 2.55% salana thi.

items: Maskan ki tabahi aur zameen ke istemal mein tabdeeli.
Qudrati wasail, jaise meetha paani aur fossil fuels, ki kami.
Jangalat ki katai aur hayati tanawwu ka nuqsan.
Nayi wabaon aur aalami wabaon, bhook aur ghizai kami ke zyada imkanaat.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Kitab batati hai ke UN ke mutabiq Pakistan ki aabadi ab 250 million se barh gayi hai aur yeh paanchwan sab se ziyada aabadi wala mulk hai. Insan zameen ke biomass ka sirf taqreeban 0.01% hain; paude taqreeban 82% aur bacteria taqreeban 13%. Sab se ameer 20% log duniya ke 86% wasail istemal karte aur 53% carbon dioxide chhorte hain, jab ke sab se ghareeb 20% sirf 1.3% istemal aur 3% kharij karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Insanon ne apne maskan ki 'carrying capacity' kaise barhayi?
blocks.explanation: Technology ke zariye: khoraak par zyada qaboo, shikariyon se difa, bimariyon ki dawaen aur mausam se bachao.

items: 1700s se technology ne insani carrying capacity barhayi.
Pakistan: 241.49 million (2023 mardum shumari), izafa 2.55% salana.
Izafa maskan ki tabahi, wasail ki kami, aaloodgi aur mausami tabdeeli laata hai.
